title: Hearty Monsoon Dutch Gruy2re Stew
description: A rich and creamy stew originating from the Dutch culinary tradition of Monsoon, characterized by its use of Gruy2re cheese and Halal-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat mantecare butter in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and add the cubed Gruy2re cheese.
Stir until the cheese has melted and the stew has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve over rice or with crusty bread.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
